articles.title: Israel kills 10 Palestinians in Gaza since dawn after two hospitals struck
articles.summary:
Israel kills 10 Palestinians in Gaza since dawn after two hospitals struck

Israeli attacks across Gaza have killed at least 10 people since dawn, includings six in an attack on southern Gaza's Nasser Medical complex, Al Jazeera reports, citing medical sources.

Wafa reported earlier that another Israeli strike hit Gaza City's al-Shifa, killing at least one Palestinian at its entrance.

Meanwhile, in central Gaza, Al Jazeera reports that there are multiple casualties after an Israeli drone struck a vehicle south of Deir el-Balah.

articles.title: Israel hands over body of Palestinian teen who died in custody
articles.summary:
Israel hands over body of Palestinian teen who died in custody

The Israeli authorities have handed over the body of 17-year-old Palestinian detainee Walid Khaled Ahmad, who died in March 2025 while held in Megiddo Prison after six months of detention, Wafa reports.

Ahmad died after he had been starved and denied medical treatment, according to the report.

His body was released following legal efforts by Nadia Daqa, a lawyer with the Commission of Detainees and Ex-Detainees Affairs.

Testimonies collected by Defence for Children International indicate that he became dizzy and collapsed on 22 March 2025. Fellow detainees said they called for help, but guards did not respond. They said they carried him to the yard gate, where guards eventually took him away.

In December 2025 an Israeli court in Hadera closed the investigation into his death, claiming all avenues had been exhausted, despite finding indications he had been starved.

Israeli authorities continue to withhold the bodies of 98 Palestinian prisoners who have died in custody since 1967.

Gideon Saar warns 'attempts to harm Israel also harm Britain' after meeting UK Conservative delegation
articles.summary:
Gideon Saar warns 'attempts to harm Israel also harm Britain' after meeting UK Conservative delegation

Israel's Minister of Foreign Affairs Gideon Saar has said that UK-Israeli relations have been "damaged" following a "series of unilateral anti-Israel measures pursued by the Labour government since 2024".

Saar made the comments following a meeting with a visting delegation from the British Conservative Party on Wednesday evening in Jerusalem.

In a post on X, he said he had briefed the group "on the strategic challenges facing Israel, including the ongoing, systematic and openly declared attempt by Iran and its allies to destroy it".

But he warned that the relationship between Israel and the UK has been damaged "against our wishes", and said that "attempts to harm Israel also harm Britain itself".

I was pleased to meet this evening in Jerusalem with a visiting delegation from the British Conservative Party, led by Party Chairman Kevin Hollinrake. I briefed our friends on the strategic challenges facing Israel, including the ongoing, systematic and openly declared attempt by Iran and its allies to destroy it. The relationship between Israel and Britain is important to both countries. Unfortunately, it has been damaged, against our wishes, by a series of unilateral anti-Israel measures pursued by the Labour government since 2024. As attorneys general from 13 U.S. states recently warned, attempts to harm Israel also harm Britain itself. Israel still has good friends in Britain, and I thanked them for standing with Israel! 🇮🇱🇬🇧 @CFoI @kevinhollinrake @A_J_Snowden @AWMurrison @drcarolinej @JeromeMayhew @gavinantonyrice

— Gideon Sa'ar | גדעון סער (@gidonsaar) November 11, 2026

articles.title: Israel occupation attack car in Gaza near Al-Shifa Hospital
articles.summary: An Israeli drone strike targeted a vehicle near Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, northern Gaza Strip, on Thursday, leaving several Palestinians injured. The injured Palestinians were reported to be in critical condition following the attack. The attacks came amid continued Israeli violations of the ceasefire agreement that took effect on Oct. 10, 2025. The violations have killed 1,622 Palestinians and wounded 5,878 others. Since October 2023, Israel’s war on Gaza has killed more than 74,600 Palestinians and wounded nearly 176,000 others. Most of those killed or wounded were women and children.
